payload.entry: PLANNING EVIDENCE: No prior phase work notes; clean base 078e3da1d6. Existing import-budget tests pass 5/5 at 2860 first-party modules against strict 2861, but historical d3d26a5b55 reproduces the exact 2863-vs-2861 AssertionError. Same-interpreter split replays: eef22a0124 adds 3 modules and bffbc8effd adds 5. Prototype normalized source-token bytes across changed source files grow only 288 and 59 respectively (prompt staging split 362fcb2e7f: 69). Authored and validated a medium tale replacing tight module counting with a shared normalized-source-footprint guard while retaining deferred modules, CPU, and loose total limits. No implementation changes made; phase remains in progress for the plan handoff. No epic-symbol entries found.

INVESTIGATION: At sase 078e3da1d6, the three October 30 examples do not show stale rows newly reaching master after close. Cleanup 0060c20fd7 (09:10:20Z) precedes sase-1pj.4.1 close (09:15:20Z); f7eb80c7a8 (09:48:21Z) precedes sase-1pj.5.1.3 close (09:53:33Z); 7da649b562 (16:19:49Z) precedes sase-1pj.5.1.4 close (16:57:24Z). The .4 history explicitly records an upstream-row close refusal before cleanup publication. ToolRun 3ca0ba01382eb58f81f4b5063766ebe1 started at 16:59:15Z for 16a--1 from older HEAD db37d68096 (14:14:05Z), with Justfile untouched. That HEAD is an ancestor of 7da649b562 and retains all eight obsolete rows. This proves a stale observer checkout against live closed-bead status, not a broken contemporary master. The approved parent scope remains sase-o7 only. Prepared a medium tale for an early evidence-based stale-checkout verification refusal and regression coverage, preserving the existing close guard and Symvision policy. No production code changed; implementation and phase closure remain for the plan coder.

PLANNING EVIDENCE: Clean base 078e3da1d6a784cfc8fd2ab783273246318660c2, zsh 5.9; no prior phase work notes or landed fix to test_zsh_smoke.py (last change 82fae375ba, 2026-09-15). The unchanged helper uses inherited PATH when bin_dir is omitted. A logged fixture shows sbd sh calls no backend, but sbd show --for invokes <completion><candidates><bead> before inserting --format. Immediate empty fixture response: startup 0.343s, completion 0.281s, exact expected buffer. Delaying only that response 6s: startup 0.339s, completion timeout 5.025s, exact reported symptom (only b'sbd show --for' received). Controlled delay reproduction, not a fresh natural full-lane reproduction. Existing ZDOTDIR and zsh disk cache are per invocation. One medium tale is sufficient: default test-owned candidate executable, inherited-PATH sentinel regression, unchanged real-zsh assertions/timeouts, bounded loaded module runs and check. Plan sase_plan_zsh_completion_pty_isolation.md validated with zero warnings; submitting it before source changes. No tracked files changed. No epic-symbol entries currently. Implementation and closure belong to the approved coder; this is planning evidence, not a TASK RESOLVED claim.

TASK RESOLVED: sase-1gz root cause was FederationLock lifetime — PreparedListener held the flock File handle by value so a cloned descriptor (try_clone / dup) kept the flock alive after drop, turning the next symlink-rejection path into AlreadyRunning instead of UnsafeSocket. Base sase-core 16a3ed0f. Fix: crates/sase_gateway/src/federation_worker/imp/listener.rs wraps the lock File in FederationLock guard with explicit fs2 unlock on Drop, so drop always releases even with duplicates alive; plus 6 listener_lock_tests. Evidence: baseline reproduced natural flake (ipc test failed iter 9/20 and 10/30 with AlreadyRunning); new deterministic test duplicate_descriptor_does_not_block_symlink_rejection failed pre-fix (got AlreadyRunning) and passes post-fix; 6 focused tests pass 100/100; loaded loop 20/20 gateway-lib passes (249 tests); mutation checks (0600->0644 fails mode assert, symlink bypass changes UnsafeSocket to Bind) restored; full sase-core check ToolRun f0bef2d0e68520ec96d40a4dbf7f2626 green; cargo fmt -p sase_gateway --check clean; git diff is only listener.rs.
